== Description ==

[[Steve Harpster]] (foreground left, black jacket, white hair, and white beard) at a table in the hall at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025, with [[Daniel Amor]] (midground, green hoodie) and [[Ming Huo]] (background, tan zip hoodie); the opponent in a blue plaid shirt, a standing man in a Seattle SuperSonics cap, and other background faces are unlabeled.
